'''Keluda's brother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] who was one of the workers at the [[Golden Nyss Shipyards]] killed when the station was blown up by the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]]. He was the brother of the assassin [[Keluda]].
